title: payment_intent.failed
description: Published by payments when a payment intent (an STK push, card or bank payment) ends without payment: failed, cancelled by the payer, or expired (data model §7: expired counts as failed) (task 4.4), in the same transaction as the intent's status. Nothing is credited. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

error_code.description: A catalogue code: a PAY code for a rail outcome, VAL-4000 for a number the rail adapter refused before calling it.

result_code.description: The rail's own result code, when it gave one.
